cardOverview.overviewText: A Shaurya card honoring defense personnel, providing lifestyle rewards, fee waivers, insurance benefits, and milestone perks tailored for armed forces.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: An insurance cover worth 2 lakhs against a personal accident.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, immediately report the incident to SBI Customer Care at 1800 1234, 1800 2100, or 1800 112211. For email support, contact customercare@sbi.co.in
